Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a large cystic lesion in the left lower lobe with a distinct air-fluid level (indicated by the arrow), which is characteristic of a hydatid cyst that has ruptured or become infected. Medical therapy with albendazole is a standard treatment for echinococcosis and is expected to reduce the size of the cyst over time, unlike bronchogenic cysts or metastatic disease.
